title: CASREP C3: SR-7 air search radar
summary: Array face B transmit/receive module failed during the morning system test. Radar degraded; it needs the TR module now in transit.

records.title: CASREP C3: SR-7 array face B
records.summary: TR module failure on array face B. Detection range reduced in the forward-starboard sector. Needs TR module assembly (REQN-KB-22918).

contradictions.note: The readiness report is 30 h old and predates the CASREP. The CASREP is current.

title: Part delayed: TR module assembly +6 days
summary: Supply updated the TR module ETA from 2 days to 8 days. The vendor tracker shows it backordered.

records.title: Requisition update: TR module assembly
records.summary: Shipment slipped. Revised ETA 8 days. Priority still 05 (routine).

records.title: Vendor tracker: TR module assembly
records.summary: Item shows backordered at the vendor. No ship date posted.

contradictions.note: Supply and the vendor disagree. The 8-day ETA may be optimistic.

title: Orders: 2 SR-7 radar techs detach in 5 days
summary: ET2 Lindqvist and ET2 Reyes received transfer orders, detaching in 5 days. Leaves 2 qualified SR-7 techs; 3 are required.

records.title: Transfer orders: ET2 Lindqvist, ET2 Reyes
records.summary: Both sailors detach in 5 days for new assignments ashore.
